newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land up on Tokyo listing plan.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land up on Tokyo listing plan.

text.p: Shares of blue-chip property group Henderson Land Development Co Ltd rose on Tuesday on buying fuelled by its plan for a secondary listing in Tokyo, brokers said.
The company's shares were up HK$0.25 to HK$72.25 in morning trade with 2.15 million shares changing hands.
"In the case of Henderson, it is not a very big issue itself so is not going to affect its EPS (earnings per share)," said Gilbert Chu, head of research at SocGen-Crosby Securities.

"The secondary listing is seen to be positive for Henderson shares," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage. "Anticipation of more Japanese interest in the stock after its Tokyo listing aided buying."
Henderson Land said earlier on Tuesday it planned to offer 30 million shares, or 1.73 percent of its issued share capital, in a proposed secondary listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
The issue price would be fixed later, it said.
It said the Japan offering was expected to take place in the coming few weeks, with dealing in the shares due to begin in early February.
